_about: Radar's US pack (app/packs/__init__.py), used only for an institution based in the US. The US is in so much of the world's news that country-level mentions would fill the query's row limit with a few hours of news, so for a US institution an article is home news only when its title names a footprint state or city (these aliases, plus the profile's own places), its locations name a footprint state HOME_MENTIONS times or more, or it is from one of these outlets. judge_rules is added to the judge's instruction.
judge_rules: Skip elections, campaigns and party politics; keep interest rates, regulation, credit, energy, power and data centers.
